decisions.reason: Although still offered, this healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is too far from the firm's maritime-focused strategy and lacks visible evidence of traction compared with higher-fit opportunities in core shipmanagement services.
Superyacht crew recruitment uses the firm's existing crewing capabilities and customer logic, making it a credible adjacent extension of the established maritime offer.
The maritime education programme fits the firm's training network and showed early market acceptance through a partner network that reached six maritime institutions soon after launch.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are strategically central to clients' regulatory needs and the firm has already demonstrated successful execution by meeting the FuelEU submission deadline for all in-scope vessels.

The emissions compliance dashboard supports the firm's push into digital, transparent and environmentally focused maritime solutions and is strengthened by integration into its PAL shipmanagement software.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool adds practical decision support for customers facing new environmental regulation and benefits from being integrated into the firm's existing software platform.
